subject.title: fix(diagnostics): derive heap thresholds from V8 heap size limit (#104631)

question: Should a gateway with an enlarged V8 heap still be classified as critically memory-pressured at the fixed 3 GiB RSS threshold, or should the default RSS policy scale with available system and heap capacity too?
rationale: The PR's heap-only adjustment cannot establish the intended behavior while the earlier fixed RSS check remains; selecting the permanent RSS policy changes availability diagnostics and bundle timing and therefore requires owner intent.

options.title: Make the classifier coherent
options.body: Scale or otherwise recalibrate the default RSS policy alongside the V8-relative heap thresholds, with realistic regression and live proof.

options.title: Keep 3 GiB RSS critical
options.body: Retain the fixed RSS boundary only if its distinct operational purpose is documented and live evidence shows it does not preserve the harmful workflow reported by the issue.

recommendation.title: Make the classifier coherent
recommendation.body: Scale or otherwise recalibrate the default RSS policy alongside the V8-relative heap thresholds, with realistic regression and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the classifier and its threshold ordering, so history most directly connects him to the intended diagnostic policy.
